theme.title: Triple-double kings
theme.subtitle: Oscar Robertson to Russell Westbrook
theme.recap: Oscar Robertson set the triple-double standard in the 1960s; Russell Westbrook passed his single-season mark in 2017 and his career total in 2021.

questions.prompt: On April 9, 2017, Russell Westbrook broke the record for triple-doubles in a season. What number did he reach?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On April 9th, Russell Westbrook broke Oscar Robertson's record for most triple-doubles in a season with 42.

questions.prompt: How many career triple-doubles did Oscar Robertson record?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For his career, Robertson had 181 triple-doubles, a record that had never been approached for decades

questions.prompt: Oscar Robertson broke Bob Cousy's single-season assist record of 715. How many did he log?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He broke the assists record by Bob Cousy, who had recorded 715 assists two seasons earlier, by logging 899

questions.prompt: Jason Kidd posted a triple-double in the 2002 Finals. It was which number in Finals history?
questions.context: 2002 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Los Angeles

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kidd finished with a triple-double, the 26th in Finals history

questions.prompt: Jimmy Butler had 40 points and 11 rebounds in Game 3 of the 2020 Finals. How many assists did he add?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Butler finished with 40 points, 11 rebounds and 13 assists for a triple-double to lead Miami to a 115–104 win
